component.name: Lunduke Paint
component.summary: Layered bitmap paint program for Linux X11

description.p: Lunduke Paint is a traditional GTK 3 paint program for Linux X11. Look and feel: classic MS Paint plus KolourPaint, with user layers and a visible history list. The project code name is Brushpad.
It uses a window-manager title bar, a menu bar, and toolbars. The native project format is OpenRaster (.ora). Flat export to PNG, JPEG, and BMP is supported.
First LCOS 0.3 package of Lunduke Paint (GTK3 layered bitmap paint).
